title: Record multispectrum review evidence for merged PR wave

deprecation_window.evidence: PR #17 is pure additions (additions=7639, deletions=0) under evidence/debate/ plus 9 appended rows to evidence/audit-chain.jsonl. No code path, schema, CLI default, ADR path, or registry contract is modified. No runtime consumer can observe a behavior diff. Migration facet has no in-scope breakage to mitigate.

schema_precedent_risk.concern: PR #17 encodes the shape `evidence/debate/pr-<N>-<facet>-r1.json` as the de-facto schema for retrospective per-PR multispectrum reviews. The naming-justification section of the PR body ratifies this shape with no schema doc, no JSON Schema file, no ADR, and no versioning marker. Per-file `round` / `reviewer_id` / `key_claims` / `findings[]` shapes diverge across the 74 files landed (compare pr-12-F13-r1 `reviewer_id: claude-F13_migration-pr-12` vs pr-15-F13-r1 `reviewer: critic`; compare pr-5-F5-r3 round numbering vs everywhere-else r1/r2). All future per-PR multispectrum evidence is now expected to follow this exact path glob, but the schema authority is the file set itself, not a contract.
broken_shape_examples: Field naming drift: `reviewer` (pr-15) vs `reviewer_id` (pr-12) for the same role
Verdict-vocabulary drift: `REJECT` (pr-15) vs `approve-with-fixups` (pr-12) — no closed enum
Optional-block drift: `whats_missing`/`ambiguity_risks`/`open_questions` present in pr-15, absent in pr-12
schema_precedent_risk.evidence: `PR #17 body`: "`evidence/debate/pr-<N>-<facet>-r1.json`: GitHub PR number + doctrine facet + review round." This locks the path shape across the repo without a corresponding JSON Schema in registry/ or docs/templates/. Future agents producing per-PR multispectrum evidence will silently inherit whichever neighbor file they grep for as a model — a classic schema-precedent migration trap.

in_flight_caller_impact.runtime_consumers: none — files under evidence/debate/ are read by humans and by `multispectrum_review` lane tooling only; no Rust build artifact, no CLI default, no CI gate currently parses this directory as authoritative
in_flight_caller_impact.audit_chain_appends: 9 `consensus_debate_complete` rows appended to evidence/audit-chain.jsonl — additive, hash-chain preserved per the F1/F3 sibling reviewers

findings.title: Schema precedent locked without a JSON Schema or ADR
findings.evidence: PR #17 body ratifies `evidence/debate/pr-<N>-<facet>-r1.json` as the canonical shape, but neither registry/ nor docs/templates/ ships a corresponding schema. Existing siblings already diverge (`reviewer` vs `reviewer_id`, `F13-PR15-1` vs `F-PR12-13`, presence/absence of `whats_missing`).
findings.impact: Every future per-PR multispectrum review will be authored by grepping a neighbor file. The shape will drift further until the multispectrum_review lane consumes it programmatically and breaks.
findings.fix: Land a follow-up PR adding `docs/templates/multispectrum-pr-review-r1.schema.json` + an ADR pinning field names, finding-id format (`F<facet>-PR<N>-<seq>`), and the verdict enum. Cite from PR #17's audit-chain row retroactively.

findings.title: No migration breadcrumb for retrospective review backfill
findings.evidence: PR adds reviews for 9 already-merged PRs (#1, #2, #3, #5, #6, #7, #8, #9, #11) without a docs/migration/ or CHANGELOG.md row noting that the multispectrum_review lane now has retroactive coverage for these SHAs.
findings.impact: A reader scanning audit-chain for when retrospective coverage began will have to diff the file tree rather than read one canonical note.
findings.fix: Add a one-line entry to docs/CHANGELOG.md (or the evidence README) recording the backfill SHA window and the PR-17 merge SHA.

whats_missing: JSON Schema file pinning the pr-<N>-<facet>-r1 shape
Closed enum for `verdict` (currently free-text across siblings)
Canonical mapping table from facet codes (F1..F13, M1, M2, A1..A7) to lens descriptions, referenceable by future per-PR files
Backfill cutoff note: which PR numbers are intentionally NOT covered (#4, #10 absent from the wave — silent gap)

ambiguity_risks.interpretation_a: The 74-file shape is illustrative and will be normalized by a later schema PR.
ambiguity_risks.interpretation_b: The 74-file shape IS the schema — future authors must mirror it verbatim including its internal drift.
ambiguity_risks.risk: Interpretation B is the realistic default given no schema doc exists; drift compounds with each new PR review.

verdict_justification: Operating in THOROUGH mode (no CRITICAL findings; 1 MAJOR + 1 MINOR did not cross the ADVERSARIAL escalation threshold). PR #17 is correctly classified `is_breaking_change=false` for the runtime/CLI/schema axes the F13 facet normally guards — the diff is pure evidence-tree additions. The legitimate migration concern is one level up: the PR codifies a file-shape precedent without a schema contract, and existing siblings already drift. Approve-with-fixups, with F13-PR17-1 tracked as a follow-up so the next per-PR review wave has a contract to validate against.
open_questions: Why are PRs #4 and #10 absent from the retrospective wave — intentional skip or oversight?
Does the multispectrum_review lane currently `jq` over evidence/debate/pr-*.json, and if so which fields does it require (de-facto schema)?
